description: Defines synchronization primitives such as CriticalSection, Semaphores, and Event classes for thread synchronization within the WPEFramework Core namespace.

classes.name: CriticalSection
classes.description: Encapsulates platform-specific critical section/mutex for thread synchronization.

classes.name: BinairySemaphore
classes.description: Implements a binary semaphore for thread synchronization.

classes.name: CountingSemaphore
classes.description: Implements a counting semaphore for thread synchronization.

classes.name: Event
classes.description: Represents an event object for thread signaling.

classes.name: SafeSyncType
classes.description: Template class for RAII-style lock management of synchronization objects.

methods.name: Lock
methods.description: Waits for the event to be signaled.

methods.name: ResetEvent
methods.description: Resets the event to non-signaled state.

methods.name: SetEvent
methods.description: Sets the event to signaled state.

methods.name: IsSet
methods.description: Checks if the event is signaled.

methods.name: SafeSyncType
methods.description: RAII lock guard for synchronization objects.
